field.label: Order
field.help: Rules are checked from the lowest number up and the first match decides.

field.label: What to do
field.help: Block stops the connection. Watch only records it. Allow ends the checks for matching traffic (an exception).

field.label: Applications
field.help: For example YouTube, Facebook, BitTorrent. Start typing a name.

field.label: Website names
field.help: Also match connections to these websites. Wildcards work: *.example.com, ads*.example.com.

field.label: Networks (LAN, VLAN)
field.help: Only devices on these networks. Empty means all networks.

field.label: Devices
field.help: Optional device addresses or networks, for example 10.77.0.25 or 10.77.0.0/24.

field.label: Named users
field.help: People from Layer 7 > Users and Access. They are recognised by their device address or, when sign-in is on, by their account.

field.label: From
field.help: HH:MM. The same start and end time means all day. A window that ends before it starts runs overnight.

field.label: Also block website categories
field.help: Older option: use Protection > Content Filtering (CFS) group rules instead.

field.label: Also block these websites by DNS
field.help: Older option: use Protection > Web Control instead.
